description: statusline-hub: keeps the plugin-data current-hooks symlink pointing at this version's hooks, so the statusLine command in settings.json stays on an update-stable path; then puts the hub in the statusLine slot on the first session (into the scope where the plugin is enabled, never over another tool's entry - that it only offers to wrap, which the user accepts with install-statusline-hub --wrap - and over the statusline plugin's entry only once that plugin draws as a hub display hook), restores the entry (or re-applies a wrap the user accepted) when a stale session's settings write dropped or reverted it, and prunes old sensor records, dead hook manifests, stale caches and logs.
